工具 干什么 read 读文件，带行号 write 写文件，没有就建 edit 替换文件里一处完全一样的字符串 multi_edit 一个文件里多处改动——要么全成，要么全不成 glob 按模式找文件（* 在一段里，** 跨目录） grep 用正则搜内容，可以要匹配的行、文件名或者计数 ls 列目录；depth: -1 是整棵树 bash 跑一条命令，可以带超时，也可以放到后台 bash_output 后台命令到目前为止的输出 bash_kill 杀掉后台命令 todo_write 这一轮要做的事 task 把一件自成一体的事交给子 agent skill 载入一个技能的说明
  • MCP 服务器的工具——mcp__<服务器>__<工具>，配了的服务器都有。
  • 插件的工具——插件可以加工具、命令和 hook。
  • 工具的 schema 会按预算裁剪——工具的 schema 最多占上下文的十分之一（tools.schema_budget_tokens 可以另设预算）；塞不下时最不重要的先走。 bash 和 read 永远不裁。
  • 工具集可以配——tools.enabled 是模型能调的工具清单，tools.disabled 是单独拿掉几个。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
模型会调这些工具，你也可以自己调来试：

{"tool": "read", "params": {"path": "src/app.py"}}
{"tool": "edit", "params": {"path": "src/app.py", "old_string": "x = 1", "new_string": "x = 2"}}
{"tool": "grep", "params": {"pattern": "def main", "output_mode": "files_with_matches"}}
{"tool": "glob", "params": {"pattern": "src/**/*.py"}}
{"tool": "ls", "params": {"path": "src", "depth": -1}}
{"tool": "bash", "params": {"command": "pytest -q", "timeout": 300}}
{"tool": "bash", "params": {"command": "pytest -q", "run_in_background": true}}
{"tool": "bash_output", "params": {"task_id": "b7f3"}}

multi_edit 收一个列表，要么全成要么全不成：

{"tool": "multi_edit", "params": {"path": "src/app.py", "edits": [
  {"old_string": "import os", "new_string": "import os\nimport sys"},
  {"old_string": "def main():", "new_string": "def main(argv=None):"}
]}}

grep 有三种模式：content（默认）、files_with_matches、count。 它最多返回 100 条匹配，glob 最多 200 个文件。

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
每个工具都不抛异常，而是回答一行 Error: ...，模型看得见这句话，可以自己 改。消息长这样：

工具 消息 read Error: file not found: {path}. Use \ls` to see what is in that directory.` read Error: '{name}' is a directory. Use \ls` to list it.` read Error: '{name}' is a binary file. edit Error: old_string not found in {path}. Use \read` to see the exact content, then retry with more context.` edit Error: old_string is not unique in {path}: it appears {count} times (lines {...}). Include more surrounding context to make it unique, or set replace_all=true. multi_edit Error: Edit #1 failed, no changes were written. {inner}——文件一个字节都没动。 grep Error: invalid regular expression '{pattern}': {error} grep Error: \output_mode` must be one of content, files_with_matches, count (got '{mode}').` glob/grep/ls Error: path not found: {path}. / Error: not a directory: {path}. bash Error: \command` is required and must be a non-empty string.` bash_output Error: unknown task id '{id}'. todo_write Error: todo #1 has invalid status '{status}'. Use one of pending, in_progress, completed. task Error: unknown sub agent '{name}'. Available sub agents: {...}. skill Error: unknown skill '{name}'. Available skills: {...}.

执行器自己的错误写在调用的结果里：

消息 什么意思 Error: unknown tool '{name}'. Available tools: {...}. 模型调了一个没注册的工具——通常是 tools.enabled 被收窄了。 Error: permission denied for '{tool}'. {reason} 规则或者模式拒绝了这次调用。 Error: the user denied '{tool}'. 有人在审批那里按了 n。 Error: '{tool}' needs approval but no approver is available. Run with --permission-mode bypass to allow it. 这次调用需要审批，但是没有终端可以问。--permission-mode bypass，或者一条允许它的规则。 Error: the hook blocked '{tool}'. {reason} PreToolUse 的 hook 拒绝了这次调用。 Error: '{tool}' failed: {type}: {e} 工具自己抛了异常。

bash 的退出码不是零不算错误：退出码是输出的一部分，写成 [exit code 1]。命令跑得比 tools.bash_timeout（默认 120 秒）久，会失败 成：

An error occurred while executing the command: Command 'sleep 60' timed out after 120 seconds

放到后台的命令回答 Started background task {id}: {cmd}，用 bash_output 读，用 bash_kill 杀。

工具的输出会写进会话日志，也会发给模型。里面长得像密钥的东西——API key、 token、密码、私钥——在写和发之前都会换成 [redacted]。带密钥的文件存进 checkpoint 时会被去掉密钥，/rewind 也不会把它恢复回去：文件保持原样， 命令会告诉你是哪一个。

docs.title: 权限
docs.text:
• 五种模式——default、acceptEdits、plan、readonly、bypass。
  • 模型会知道——plan 和 readonly 下 agent 知道自己改不了东西， 于是把看到的说出来，而不是动手。
  • 规则——~/.coderagent/rules.yaml 和 .coderagent/rules.yaml 按工具 和模式决定放不放行。用户级那份赢。
  • Always allow——审批卡片上的这个按钮会写一条规则，以后同一个调用 （同一个文件、同一条命令）直接放行。
  • 禁止的路径——permissions.deny_paths，agent 不许碰的路径。
  • 额外的目录——permissions.include_dirs，工作目录以外、agent 仍然 可以碰的目录。
  • 三个答案——允许、拒绝、永久允许。没人回答就是拒绝：浏览器里等 ui.approval_timeout 秒（默认五分钟），终端里一直等，因为那儿坐着人。
  • 终端里用方向键选答案，浏览器里点卡片上的按钮；没有终端时一律拒绝。
  • hook 跑在权限检查前面——hook 可以改写这次调用或者拦下来，权限检查 看到的是改写之后的那次。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
没有规则的时候，由模式决定：

模式 read、glob、grep、ls write、edit、multi_edit bash todo_write、bash_output、bash_kill default 允许 问 问¹ 允许 acceptEdits 允许 允许 问¹ 允许 plan 允许 拒绝 拒绝 允许 readonly 允许 拒绝 拒绝 允许 bypass 允许 允许 允许 允许

规则文件按工具和模式决定：

# ~/.coderagent/rules.yaml
rules:
  - tool: bash
    pattern: "pytest"
    decision: allow
    reason: the test suite is safe to run
  - tool: edit
    pattern: "src/**/*.py"
    decision: allow
  - tool: "*"
    pattern: "*"
    decision: ask

pattern 对路径类工具是 glob（* 在一段里，** 跨目录），对 bash 是 正则，别的工具就是工具名。对 bash，这个正则要对上命令每一段的开头： git push 能对上 git push origin main，但对不上 echo "git push"。

¹ 只是看的命令——ls、cat、grep、git status 之类——直接放行，不问； 其余的问。详见下面的命令行。

coder -t "跑一下测试" --permission-mode acceptEdits
coder -t "这个要怎么修？" --permission-mode plan

plan 和 readonly 会往给模型看的消息里塞一段说明：

<permission_mode mode="plan">
You are in plan mode. You may only look around: `read`, `glob`, `grep` and `ls`
work, but every tool that changes something, `bash` included, is refused.
Investigate the task and answer with the plan you would follow. The user
decides whether it is executed.
</permission_mode>

审批上的 Always allow 会往 ~/.coderagent/rules.yaml 写一条规则：

rules:
  - tool: bash
    pattern: pytest
    decision: allow
    reason: always allowed by the user

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 Error: permission denied for 'write'. '{path}' is outside the working directory {cwd} agent 想碰工作目录以外的路径。 把那个目录加进 permissions.include_dirs，或者换工作目录。 Error: the user denied 'write'. 有人在审批那里拒了。 允许它，或者为它写条规则。 Error: 'write' needs approval but no approver is available. Run with --permission-mode bypass to allow it. 这次运行没有终端（脚本或者 CI），而工具要审批。 --permission-mode bypass，或者一条 decision: allow 的规则。 {path}:{line}: invalid decision '{d}', expected one of allow, ask, deny 规则文件里的决定值不对。 用 allow、ask 或 deny。 {path}:{line}: unknown rule keys: {keys} 规则里有不存在的键。 键只有 tool、pattern、decision、reason。 {path}: invalid YAML: {error} 规则文件解析不了。 修 YAML，消息里带着行号。 {path}: \rules` must be a list|rules` 不是一个列表。 写成一个由映射组成的列表。 Error: permission denied for 'bash'. '{path}' is outside the working directory {cwd} 命令里点了工作目录以外的路径。 用工作目录里的路径，或者用 permissions.include_dirs 打开那个目录。

decision: allow 的规则不会把整块磁盘打开：工作目录以外的路径还是 碰不到，除非它在 permissions.include_dirs 里。用户级的规则也不能放宽这个 边界。

permissions.deny_paths 加的是一条「全部拒绝」的规则，它在规则文件之后 生效，所以同样路径上的 allow 打不过它。

docs.title: 命令行
docs.text:
bash 是唯一什么都能干的工具，所以它有三条边界。

只是看的命令直接放行。 ls、cat、head、tail、grep、diff、wc、 jq，还有 git 里读东西的那些子命令（status、diff、log、show……） 是安全的：它们不改东西，也不联网，所以不问。

会毁东西或者把东西送出去的命令要问。 rm、mv、cp、chmod、curl、 wget、ssh、pip、npm、docker、git push 这些。它们不是被拒绝——由 人来决定，审批上会写清楚这条命令干什么（「把数据送出这台机器」）。在 bypass 下它们照常放行，因为那儿没有人可问。

工作目录以外的路径被拒绝。 cat /etc/passwd、cat ../secret、 cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa、cd .. 在任何模式下都被拒绝，和文件工具的路径一样。 系统的程序可以点名（/bin/ls），但数据不许离开工作目录。 permissions.include_dirs 可以打开工作目录以外的目录。

命令的每一段都单独判，取最严的那一段：放行了 pytest 也不代表跟着它的 rm 一起放行。

ls -la                       # 放行
git status                   # 放行
curl http://example.com      # 要问：把数据送出这台机器
pytest -q && rm -rf build    # 要问：rm 是危险的
cat /etc/passwd              # 拒绝

docs.title: 会话
docs.text:
• 新建、列出、续接、复制——--resume、--continue、--fork、--list。
  • 事件日志是唯一的事实——每条消息、每次工具调用、每个结果、每笔钱都 追加进一个 JSONL 文件。会话靠重放它重建。
  • 检查点——每次写文件之前存一份快照，/rewind 能退回去。
  • /clear——开一个新会话，旧的留在日志里。
  • 花了多少钱——每个会话的 token 和花费，在状态栏、在 /cost、在 追踪文件里。
  • 追踪——coder export --format json|otel 把会话导出来，给看板或者 OpenTelemetry 用。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
coder -t "第一个任务"                     # 新会话
coder --list                              # 这个目录的会话
coder --resume 20261109-3f0a91 -t "接着说"  # 续上那个
coder --continue -t "接着说"                # 续上这个目录里最新的
coder --fork 20261109-3f0a91 -t "另一条路"  # 复制一份，原来那份不动

一个会话的文件都在 ~/.coderagent/ 里：

~/.coderagent/sessions/20261109-3f0a91.jsonl        # 事件日志
~/.coderagent/sessions/20261109-3f0a91.meta.json    # id、cwd、created_at、model_name
~/.coderagent/checkpoints/20261109-3f0a91.json       # 写文件前的快照

事件日志一行一个 JSON 对象，类型有 user_message、assistant_message、 tool_call、tool_result、approval_request、approval_response、 state_change、compaction、reflection、verify、reverted_to、error、 turn_end。

/rewind 只还原文件——命令对外部世界做过的事还是做过了——并把会话的 历史截断到快照那一刻。

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 ValueError: no checkpoint '<id>' in this session /rewind 拿到的 id 不是这个会话的检查点。 不带 id 的 /rewind 会列出检查点。 /resume <不存在的 id> 起了一个目录是 . 的会话 日志里没有这个 id 不会报错，它会造一个空会话。 用 coder --list 看看有哪些 id。 一轮以 stop_reason: max_turns 结束 agent 用了 50 次模型调用还没完（agent.max_turns）。 调大 agent.max_turns，或者把任务拆小。 一轮以 stop_reason: cost_exceeded 结束 这一轮花的钱超过了 agent.cost_limit。0 是没有上限。 调大 agent.cost_limit。 一轮以 stop_reason: token_limit 结束 这一轮用的 token 超过了 agent.token_limit。0 是没有上限。模型没有价格时钱不动，token 就是预算。 调大 agent.token_limit。 一轮以 stop_reason: error 结束 模型调用重试完了还是失败。错误文本在 error 里。 看 error，那是厂商的消息。 一轮以 stop_reason: interrupted 结束 有人按了 ctrl+c。 会话已经存下来了，用 --resume 接着来。

以 cost_exceeded 或 error 结束的一轮不会被沉淀成记忆：记忆里只留 失败之前学到的东西。

docs.title: 上下文
docs.text:
• token 是数出来的——装了 tiktoken 就精确数，没装就估。
  • 窗口跟着模型走——DeepSeek 64k、Claude 200k、GPT 128k 这样。配置文件 里写了 context_window 就以它为准。
  • 自动压缩——对话到窗口的 80 % 就做摘要、把历史缩短。摘要是结构化的： 目标、发现、决定、动过的文件、没解决的问题、下一步、见过的错。
  • 留什么——最近几轮，或者最近 40 % 的 token，哪个多留哪个。
  • /compact——随时手动压缩。
  • 消息的顺序——系统提示词、指令文件、todo、会话摘要，然后是历史。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
context:
  context_window: 64000
  compact_threshold: 0.8
  keep_recent_turns: 20
  keep_recent_token_ratio: 0.4
  compact_every_turns: 40
  summarize_model: deepseek/deepseek-flash

配置里没有 context_window 时，窗口跟着模型名字走：gpt- 128k、claude 200k、deepseek 64k、qwen 32k、llama 8k、gemini 1M、mistral 32k、 kimi 256k、minimax 200k，别的都是 200k。

摘要是一个 JSON 对象，键是这些：

{
  "goal": "fix the failing test in test_api.py",
  "findings": ["the timeout of the client is 5 seconds, the test needs 10"],
  "decisions": ["raise the timeout in the fixture"],
  "files_touched": ["tests/test_api.py"],
  "open_questions": [],
  "next_steps": ["run the suite again"],
  "errors_seen": ["TimeoutError after 5 seconds"]
}

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 ... (nothing left to compact) 这一轮因为上下文太大而失败，而且已经没什么可缩的了。 调大 context.context_window，调小 context.reserved_output，或者 /clear 重来。 摘要是个兜底版本，不是真的摘要 模型没按摘要的 JSON 回答。试两次之后就用保守摘要：最后五条消息，next_steps 是 ["re-read the files that were mentioned to recover the details"]。 不用管，会话继续走。再问模型一次那些细节。 recent_errors 是空的，但会话里明明有错 只有以 Error: 开头的工具消息会被收集，而且只留最后三条。 不用管。

token 的计数：装了 tiktoken 是精确的，没装是估的 int(chars / 3.6) + 4 * len(messages)。估小了会让压缩来晚一点，所以长会话 值得装 tiktoken。

docs.title: 记忆
docs.text:
• 项目记忆——.coderagent/memory，一轮结束时把关于项目的东西写下来。
  • 用户记忆——~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md，记用户的偏好。
  • 偏好要等人确认——先落在 pending-memory.md，/memory confirm 才写 进去。
  • 指令文件——项目的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md、用户的 CLAUDE.md， agent 都读。
  • 可以关掉——memory.enabled。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
三个文件：

.coderagent/memory/projects.md        # agent 学到的关于项目的东西
.coderagent/pending-memory.md         # 等着被确认的偏好
~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md                # 已经确认过的偏好

一轮结束时，agent 看最后 40 条消息，把学到的写下来：

# Project memory

- the tests of the API are run with `pytest tests/`, they need a postgres on localhost
- the release is made with `bump2version`, not with a manual edit of setup.py

用户的偏好先进 pending-memory.md：

# Preferences waiting for a confirmation

- always answer in Chinese

/memory confirm 之后才进 ~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md：

## Preferences

- always answer in Chinese

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 The memory was not written: {path} would grow past 200 lines; tidy it up first. 那个文件会超过 200 行。 把文件写短一点，或者拆开。 日志里的警告 The reflection of the session failed 模型没有按预期的 JSON 回答，所以什么都没写。会话本身没事。 不用管，下一轮会再试。 Wrote 2 preference(s) to /Users/you/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md. 确认成功了。 — Nothing like that in the memory. /memory forget 没找到那段文字。 用 /memory 看看现在有什么。 Removed. /memory forget 把那段文字删了。 —

记忆可以整个关掉：

memory:
  enabled: false

docs.title: 扩展
docs.text:
• 子 agent——.coderagent/agents/*.md：名字、说明、系统提示词、工具 清单、最大轮数。code-explorer、verifier、refactorer 是自带的。 模型看得见它们的索引，能直接按名字调。
  • 技能——.coderagent/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md：某类任务的步骤、脚本和 模板。合适的时候 agent 自己会载入。
  • 插件——.coderagent/plugins：一个 Python 模块，能加工具、命令和 hook。第一次用要信任一次。
  • hook——六个时机：SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、PreToolUse、 PostToolUse、Stop、SessionEnd。hook 是一条命令，读 JSON 答 JSON： 允许、拒绝、拦下来，带理由、带额外上下文，或者带改写过的参数。
  • 自己的命令——.coderagent/commands/*.md：一个 slash 命令，带说明、 参数提示、能用的工具，还有自己的模型。
  • MCP 服务器——stdio。它们的工具和别的工具一样，工具名是 mcp__<服务器>__<工具>，一样要审批，断了会自己重连。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
一个子 agent，.coderagent/agents/scout.md：

---
name: scout
description: Finds the place where a feature is implemented
tools: read, grep, glob, ls
model_purpose: cheap
max_turns: 15
---

You look for code. You never change anything. You answer with the files and
the line numbers.

模型把它当工具调：

{"tool": "task", "params": {"subagent_type": "scout", "description": "where is the auth?", "prompt": "find the auth code"}}

回答是一个 JSON 对象：

{
  "status": "ok",
  "summary": "The auth is in src/auth/session.py.",
  "findings": ["src/auth/session.py:42 defines create_session"],
  "files_touched": [],
  "cost": 0.0004,
  "turns": 3,
  "purpose": "cheap"
}

一个技能，.coderagent/skills/release/SKILL.md：

---
name: release
description: How to make a release of this project
---

1. Run the test suite.
2. Run `bump2version patch`.
3. Push the tag.

一个 hook，写在配置里：

hooks:
  events:
    PreToolUse:
      - matcher: "bash"
        hooks:
          - type: command
            command: ./.coderagent/hooks/check_secrets.sh
            timeout: 10
            strict: false

hook 从 stdin 读 JSON，往 stdout 写 JSON：

{"decision": "block", "reason": "the command writes a secret"}

decision 是 allow、deny 或 block；hook 还可以带 additionalContext， 或者用 updatedInput 改写这次调用。工具的 updatedInput 是一份参数映射； UserPromptSubmit 的 updatedInput 是一个字符串，用来改写用户的提问。

一个自己的命令，.coderagent/commands/commit.md：

---
description: Make a commit of the changes
argument-hint: [message]
allowed-tools: bash, read
model: cheap
---

Commit everything with the message: $ARGUMENTS

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 Error: unknown sub agent 'scout'. Available sub agents: code-explorer, refactorer, verifier. 索引里没有这个子 agent。 用列出来的名字；自己写的那些在系统提示词的索引里。 Error: the sub agents are not available in this session. task 工具没注册——tools.enabled 被收窄了。 把 task 放回 tools.enabled。 Error: unknown skill 'release'. Available skills: {...}. 这个技能不存在。 技能是 .coderagent/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md。 Trusted 'x'. It is loaded the next time the agent starts. /plugins trust x 的回答。 下次起 agent 才会用上这个插件。 Error: the hook blocked 'bash'. the command writes a secret PreToolUse 的 hook 拒绝了这次调用。 改命令，或者改 hook。 Hook 'check_secrets.sh' timed out, ignoring it hook 跑得比它的超时久。调用放行。 调大 timeout，或者让 hook 快点。 Hook 'check_secrets.sh' failed with RuntimeError: ... hook 崩了。调用放行。 修 hook。加 strict: true 就会挡住调用。 Error: the MCP server 'echo' is not connected. 服务器没跑起来。 检查服务器的 command；/mcp 里会写 not connected 或者 failed: <错误>。 Error: the MCP tool 'echo' failed: RuntimeError: ... 服务器回的错。消息里的名字是服务器那边的名字。 服务器的消息就在答案里。

自己的命令只在 <cwd>/.coderagent/commands/*.md 里找——agent 不会一层层 往上找。

docs.title: 沙箱
docs.text:
• 默认是本机——命令就在工作目录里跑。
  • 也可以是容器——docker、singularity、bubblewrap、contree， 还有 SWE-rex 的远程沙箱。和 mini-swe-agent 用的是同一批环境。
  • 只有 bash 进沙箱——文件工具还在工作目录里。
  • /sandbox——告诉你命令在哪里跑。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
sandbox:
  type: swerex_docker
  image: python:3.11

一共有七种：local、docker、singularity、bubblewrap、contree、 swerex_docker、swerex_modal。环境不认识的选项会被忽略，所以一个文件里 可以同时写好几种环境的设置。

/sandbox 回答类型、生效的选项和在用的环境：

type: local
environment: local

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text: 你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 ValueError: Unknown environment type: nope (resolved to nope, available: {...}) 类型不是那七种之一。 用上面列出的名字。 CalledProcessError: Command '[...]' returned non-zero exit status 1. 容器起不来，或者镜像拉不下来。 检查镜像名字，以及 docker 是不是在跑。 FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'singularity' 这个环境的二进制没装。 装上，或者换一个类型。 文件工具动到了宿主机的文件 只有 bash 进沙箱。 这是设计如此：read、edit 这些工具动的是会话的工作目录。

docs.title: 校验
docs.text:
• 默认不开——不配 verify.commands 就什么都不查。
  • agent 必须把检查跑通——模型想停下的时候命令会跑一遍；有一条没过，就把输出还给 agent，让它接着改。
  • 命令在会话的环境里跑——有沙箱就在沙箱里，所以检查看到的世界和 agent 干活的 世界是同一个。这些命令不ask要审批。
  • 轮数有限——verify.max_rounds（默认 3）。轮数用完，这一轮就以 stop_reason: verify_failed 结束。
  • 结果进事件日志——一条 verify 事件记着命令和没过的那几条。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
verify:
  commands:
    - python -m pytest -q
  max_rounds: 3
  timeout: 300

模型说做完了、而测试没过的时候，agent 会收到这样一段：

[verify] These commands did not pass. Fix the problem and try again.

$ python -m pytest -q
2 failed, 1 passed
[exit code 1]

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text: 你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 这一轮以 stop_reason: verify_failed 结束 verify.max_rounds 轮用完了，命令还是没过。 在事件日志里看最后一轮的输出。 检查在沙箱里跑，但找不到文件 沙箱里没有会话的工作目录。 给环境配一个工作目录，或者用 local。 检查跑太久 命令超过 verify.timeout 秒被杀掉了。 调大 verify.timeout。 agent 反复改同一处 检查要的东西 agent 做不到。 改检查，或者改任务。

docs.title: 终端界面
docs.text:
• 答案是流式出来的——正文和思考过程都是。
  • 状态栏——模型、token、花费、目录、权限模式。
  • 工具卡片——这次调用、输出、以及这次改动的 diff。
  • 审批——y、n、a，或者方向键在带编号的列表上选。
  • 长输出折起来——有意思的那部分留在眼前。
  • todo 面板——这一轮要做的事。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
状态栏长这样：

deepseek/deepseek-flash | 1.5k/64k | $0.0000 | ~/work/project | default

审批是一个带编号的列表，选中的那个有标记：

1 [*] y allow
2 [-] n deny
3 [-] a always allow

←/→ 移动光标，↑/↓ 也一样，数字键直接跳到那一行，空格切换多选， enter 确认，y、n、a 直接回答。ctrl+c 打断这一轮，ctrl+q 收尾 会话并退出。

todo 面板用 ◉（完成）、◐（进行中）、○（待办）标记任务状态。

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text: 你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 工具要审批时界面没反应 没有终端——这次运行是无头的。 这次调用会被拒。用 --permission-mode bypass 或者写条规则。 工具输出下面有 ▸ 42 more lines 输出比卡片长。 有意思的部分还在眼前；要全文就打开文件，或者把命令的输出调少再跑一次。 界面起不来 终端里不给任务的 coder 会起界面；没有终端就打印 no task given。 用 coder --tui 强制起。

docs.title: 网页版
docs.text:
• 聊天页——三栏：左边是会话和文件，中间是对话，右边是状态、改动和 文件。
  • 答案是流式到的——走 SSE，中途才打开页面的浏览器看到的是整段回答。
  • 设置页——模型写成表单，每个字段下面写着它来自哪一层，底下的表格 列出所有层，密钥都被抹掉。
  • 测一下连接——发一次最便宜的调用，顺带告诉模型会不会调工具。
  • 测一个模型——一块独立的面板：端点、key、模型名，不写任何文件。
  • 权限在两个地方——设置页管下一个会话，聊天页管当前这个会话，立刻生效。
  • 浏览器里也有审批——同样三个答案。
  • 语言——英文和中文。顶栏的下拉框换语言时整个页面当场换掉，不刷新， 选择记在浏览器和 cookie 里；访客没选过的时候由地址所在的地区决定。
  • 安全模型——没有认证，默认只听 127.0.0.1，写接口要一个跨站请求 发不出来的头，路径出不了工作目录，key 只在你要的时候才露面。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
coder web --cwd . --port 8765

coder web: http://127.0.0.1:8765

接口就是普通 HTTP。给会话发一条消息：

curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/sessions/20261109-3f0a91/messages \
  -H 'X-Coder-Client: 1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "run the tests"}'

订阅会话的事件流：

curl -N http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/sessions/20261109-3f0a91/stream

接口一览：

接口 干什么 GET /api/sessions 工作目录里的会话 POST /api/sessions 新建会话 GET /api/sessions/{id} 一个会话 GET /api/sessions/{id}/events 会话的事件 GET /api/sessions/{id}/items 某个序号之后的条目 GET /api/sessions/{id}/stream 事件流（SSE） GET /api/sessions/{id}/status 状态、模型、token、花费 GET /api/sessions/{id}/metrics 会话的指标 GET /api/sessions/{id}/changes 改动过的文件 POST /api/sessions/{id}/resume 续接会话 POST /api/sessions/{id}/fork 复制会话 POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages 发消息 POST /api/sessions/{id}/interrupt 打断这一轮 POST /api/sessions/{id}/mode 改这个会话的权限模式 POST /api/approvals/{id} 回答审批 GET /api/commands slash 命令 GET /api/config 配置和它的层 PUT /api/config/model 把模型写进用户级文件 GET /api/config/model/key 端点的 key PUT /api/config/permissions 把权限写进用户级文件 POST /api/config/model/test 一次最便宜的调用，测模型 GET /api/files 工作目录里的文件 GET /api/file 一个文件 GET /api/diff 一个文件的 diff GET /api/i18n/{language} 一种语言的文案

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text:
状态码 消息 什么意思 怎么办 403 the X-Coder-Client header is missing 写操作没带那个头。别的站点的浏览器发不出这个头。 加上 -H 'X-Coder-Client: 1'。 404 there is no session with the id {id} id 不存在。 GET /api/sessions 看列表。 404 no approval is waiting for the id {id} 这个审批已经答过了，或者它超时了。 不用管。 404 unknown language /api/i18n/{language} 的语言没上线。 用 en 或 zh。 400 the message is empty 消息没有内容。 给点文字。 400 unknown permission mode '{value}' 模式不是那五个之一。 用 default、acceptEdits、plan、readonly 或 bypass。 400 the decision must be allow, deny or always 审批的回答不对。 用 allow、deny 或 always。 400 '{path}' is not a directory 文件接口的路径是个文件。 换成目录。 403 '{path}' is outside the working directory {cwd} 路径走出了工作目录。 没有办法——这就是边界。 409 the session {id} is running 会话正忙着，不能复制或续接。 等这一轮结束，或者打断它。

没人回答的审批在 ui.approval_timeout 秒之后被拒，浏览器会收到 timed_out: true。

批准一个会改文件的工具，会往 ~/.coderagent/rules.yaml 写一条规则——和 终端用的是同一个文件。

服务起来时会把地址打出来。用 --host 0.0.0.0 时它会警告：

The web interface listens on 0.0.0.0: everybody who can reach that address can drive the agent.

docs.title: 配置
docs.text:
• 四层——包里的默认值、项目文件 .coderagent/config.yaml、用户文件 ~/.coderagent/config.yaml、命令行的覆盖（-c key=value）。后面的赢。
  • 有哪些段——model、agent、tools、permissions、context、 memory、checkpoint、mcp、hooks、ui、sandbox、verify。
  • 路径——MSWEA_CODER_HOME 可以把用户级文件挪到别处。
  • 设置页只写用户级文件——项目级那份在仓库里，永远不写。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
# 一个文件。
coder -t "..." -c myconf.yaml
# 覆盖，可以给多次。
coder -t "..." -c model.model_name=deepseek/deepseek-chat -c agent.max_turns=20

四层，从低到高：

  1. 包里的默认值（src/coderagent/config/defaults.yaml），
  2. 项目的 .coderagent/config.yaml，
  3. 用户的 ~/.coderagent/config.yaml，
  4. 命令行的 -c。

模型名按这个顺序找：命令行的 -c、项目文件、用户文件、 $MSWEA_MODEL_NAME，最后是 anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5。

各段和它们的键：

段 键 model model_name、model_kwargs、max_retries、litellm_config、routing、routing_rules、set_cache_control agent system_prompt、max_turns、cost_limit、token_limit、subagent_max_turns、subagent_max_parallel tools enabled、disabled、bash_timeout、max_output_tokens、schema_budget_tokens permissions mode、rules、deny_paths、include_dirs context context_window、reserved_output、compact_threshold、keep_recent_turns、keep_recent_token_ratio、compact_every_turns、auto_compact、summarize_model、summary_chunk_tokens memory project_path、user_path、enabled checkpoint enabled、keep mcp servers、timeout hooks events ui theme、show_reasoning、approval_timeout sandbox type 和环境的那些选项

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text: 你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 什么都没发生，设置被忽略了 不存在的键会被静默忽略。 按上面的表核对拼写。 yaml.scanner.ScannerError 某一层的 YAML 解析不了。 修 YAML，消息里带着行号。 pydantic_core.ValidationError 值的类型不对——该是数字的地方写了字符串。 消息里说了是哪个字段。 FileNotFoundError: Could not find config file for ... (tried: [...]) 给了 -c myconf.yml，但找的是 myconf.yaml。 用带 .yaml 的名字，或者给全路径。 模型不是文件里写的那一个 上面的一层赢了。 记住顺序；设置页上有各层的列表。 ui.show_reasoning 没有效果 这个键存在，但还没有人读它。 终端里模型的思考过程一直都是显示的。

docs.title: 命令
docs.text:
二十五个内置命令：/help、/model、/mode、/plan、/compact、 /clear、/resume、/fork、/rewind、/diff、/init、/cost、 /todos、/mcp、/permissions、/hooks、/agents、/skills、 /plugins、/memory、/status、/sandbox、/export、/context、 /exit（别名 /quit）。

自己的命令放在 .coderagent/commands/*.md，和它们一起用。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
coder -t "/cost"          # 终端里跑一个命令
coder -t "/model deepseek/deepseek-chat"
coder -t "/mode plan"

带参数的命令，参数是这一行的剩下的部分：

/model deepseek/deepseek-chat
/rewind 20261109-3f0a91

浏览器里，命令在聊天页的命令面板里，列表来自 GET /api/commands。

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text: 你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 Unknown command '/foo'. Try /help. 没有这个命令。 /help 看列表，/help <名字> 看某一个。 Unknown mode 'bogus'. Use one of: default, acceptEdits, plan, bypass, readonly. /mode 给了一个不存在的模式。会话的模式没变。 用那五个之一。 /rewind 拿到的 id 不是检查点 ValueError: no checkpoint '<id>' in this session 不带 id 的 /rewind 会列出检查点。 Not a git repository: {cwd} /diff 跑的是 git diff，而这个目录不是仓库。 在仓库里跑，或者看网页版的改动。 {path} already exists. /init 不会覆盖已有的 AGENTS.md。 自己改那个文件。 No sessions yet. /resume 不带 id 时，这个目录里什么都没有。 先跑一轮。

docs.title: mini-swe-agent 的 benchmark 那部分
docs.text:
• mini——一个运行脚本：任务、模型、环境，外加一个轨迹文件。
  • SWE-bench——整个数据集，能并行，能切片能过滤。
  • SWE-bench 单个实例——一道题。
  • ProgramBench——编程 benchmark。
  • Inspector——读轨迹文件，看 agent 干了什么。
  • 环境——local、docker、singularity、bubblewrap、contree、SWE-rex 的 docker 和 modal。
  • 模型——litellm 覆盖大多数厂商，另外还有 portkey、openrouter、 requesty、基于文本的模型和 roulette 模型。

docs.title: 用法例子
docs.text:
mini --model litellm/deepseek/deepseek-flash --environment-class docker \
  --task "the failing test is in test_api.py"

mini-extra swebench --model litellm/deepseek/deepseek-flash --workers 8 \
  --slice 0:100

一次运行的轨迹是一个 JSON 文件，里面有每一步的消息、工具调用和花费； inspector 读它。

docs.title: 出错时怎么办
docs.text: 你看到的 什么意思 怎么办 环境建不起来 镜像没有，或者这个环境的二进制没装。 和 coding agent 的沙箱那些错误一样。 模型回答里没有工具调用 benchmark 用的模型是基于文本的，或者回答的格式不对。 换一个会说工具协议的模型，或者用 benchmark 里有包装的那个模型类。

docs.title: 细节在哪
docs.text: 文档 里面有什么 coding agent 概览 从第一次会话到所有文件，全套 命令 每个命令，以及自己的命令 网页版 聊天页、设置页、API 子 agent 怎么写一个子 agent 技能 怎么写一个技能 hook 六个时机和 hook 的回答 插件 怎么写一个插件 MCP 服务器 服务器怎么配 记忆 那些文件和确认 模型路由 用途和规则 沙箱 那些环境 追踪导出 一个会话的追踪 快速开始 头十分钟

docs.title: Hooks
docs.text: A hook is a command of the user that runs at an important moment of a session. A hook can block an action, rewrite its arguments or add something to the context of the model.

docs.title: The configuration
docs.text:
hooks:
  events:
    PreToolUse:
      - matcher: "bash"
        hooks:
          - type: command
            command: ./scripts/guard.sh
            timeout: 10
    PostToolUse:
      - matcher: "edit|write"
        hooks:
          - type: command
            command: ruff format {file}
Key What it is Default type The kind of the hook. Only command is implemented command matcher A regular expression of the tool names. Empty means every tool command The command to run, with the shell, in the directory of the session timeout How long it may take, in seconds 10 strict When the hook fails, block the action instead of letting it through false

The hooks of the project live in .coderagent/config.yaml, the hooks of the user in ~/.coderagent/config.yaml. A plugin may bring hooks too. The two files are merged like the rest of the configuration: the events are merged, but the list of the hooks of one event is replaced by the list of the user.

The matcher is matched against the name of the tool, so it only means something for PreToolUse and PostToolUse. Leave it empty for the other events. It is a regular expression that is searched, not anchored: the name multi_edit matches edit|write, and the letters are case sensitive, so Bash matches nothing. A matcher that is not a valid regular expression is logged and matches nothing.

docs.title: The moments
docs.text:
Hook When What it can do SessionStart The session starts Nothing. It is a notification UserPromptSubmit After the prompt, before the model Add context, rewrite the prompt, or block it PreToolUse Before the tool runs Deny it, or rewrite the arguments PostToolUse After the tool ran Add context, or block the result Stop The agent wants to stop Send it back to work SessionEnd The turn ends Nothing. It is a notification

SessionEnd runs at the end of every turn, not only when the whole session is over.

Each event has its own payload:

Hook What it reads SessionStart session_id, cwd UserPromptSubmit prompt PreToolUse tool, params PostToolUse tool, params, result Stop last_message SessionEnd session_id, turns, cost

docs.title: What a hook answers
docs.text:
The hook reads the details on its standard input and writes its answer as JSON on its standard output:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import sys

payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
if payload.get("tool") == "bash" and "rm -rf" in payload["params"].get("command", ""):
    print(json.dumps({"decision": "deny", "reason": "that command is not allowed"}))

The keys are:

  • decision: allow, deny or block. Only deny and block are looked at — allow has no effect, it neither approves the call nor skips the permission check.
  • reason: why. It goes back to the model as the error of the tool.
  • additionalContext: something for the model to read.
  • updatedInput: the new input of the moment. For PreToolUse it is a mapping and it replaces the arguments of the tool. For UserPromptSubmit it is a string and it replaces the prompt. At PostToolUse the tool has already run, so a mapping there replaces nothing.

Nothing on the standard output means the hook has no opinion. The output of several hooks is put together: a deny wins over everything, the contexts are concatenated and the last updatedInput wins.

docs.title: What the answer does
docs.text:
The answer What happens PreToolUse denies The tool call fails, the reason goes back to the model PreToolUse rewrites the arguments The tool runs with the new arguments PreToolUse allows Nothing. The permission check still runs PostToolUse denies The message that goes back to the model becomes an error. The log keeps the result of the tool PostToolUse adds context The context is appended to the result of the tool UserPromptSubmit denies The turn ends with an error, the model is not called UserPromptSubmit adds context The context is appended to the prompt UserPromptSubmit rewrites the prompt The model sees the new prompt, the log keeps both Stop denies The agent goes on, the reason is a new message for it. At most three times per turn

The PreToolUse hook runs before the permission check, so the command that is approved is the command that was rewritten.

docs.title: A hook that rewrites the prompt
docs.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import sys

payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(json.dumps({"updatedInput": payload["prompt"] + "\n\nAnswer in English."}))

The model never sees the text the user typed, only the rewritten one. The event log keeps the prompt of the model, so a replay of the session says the same thing, and the text of the user beside it under original. In the web interface the bubble shows what the user typed, with a line below it that says what the agent was given.

A hook that answers with a string updatedInput at PreToolUse changes nothing: only a mapping replaces the arguments of a tool.

docs.title: When a hook fails
docs.text:
A hook that crashes, times out or writes something that is not JSON is ignored: the action goes on.

strict: true changes one thing: a hook that ends with a non-zero exit code denies the action, and its standard error is the reason. A timeout and a broken answer are ignored either way.

docs.title: Hooks
docs.text:
hook 是用户自己写的命令，在会话的关键时刻跑一次。它可以拦住一次操作、改写它的参数，或者给模型补一点上下文。

英文版：Hooks

docs.title: 配置
docs.text:
hooks:
  events:
    PreToolUse:
      - matcher: "bash"
        hooks:
          - type: command
            command: ./scripts/guard.sh
            timeout: 10
    PostToolUse:
      - matcher: "edit|write"
        hooks:
          - type: command
            command: ruff format {file}
键 是什么 默认值 type hook 的种类。只实现了 command command matcher 工具名的正则。空表示所有工具 command 要跑的命令，用 shell 跑，在会话的目录里 timeout 最多跑多久，单位是秒 10 strict hook 失败时拦住这次操作，而不是放行 false

项目的 hook 写在 .coderagent/config.yaml，用户的 hook 写在 ~/.coderagent/config.yaml。插件也可以带 hook。 两个文件像其它配置一样合并：事件是合并的，但同一个事件下 hook 的那份列表会被用户那份整个换掉。

matcher 是拿工具名去匹配的，所以它只对 PreToolUse 和 PostToolUse 有意义。其它事件留空就行。 它是搜出来的正则，不是从头对上的：工具名 multi_edit 会被 edit|write 匹配上；大小写敏感， 所以 Bash 什么也匹配不到。正则本身写坏了会记一条日志，然后什么也不匹配。

docs.title: 六个时刻
docs.text:
Hook 什么时候 能做什么 SessionStart 会话开始 什么也不做，是个通知 UserPromptSubmit 拿到提问之后、问模型之前 补上下文、改写提问，或者拦住提问 PreToolUse 工具跑之前 拒绝，或者改写参数 PostToolUse 工具跑完之后 补上下文，或者把结果拦下来 Stop agent 想停下来 让它回去接着干 SessionEnd 这一轮结束 什么也不做，是个通知

SessionEnd 是每一轮结束时都跑，不是只在整个会话结束时。

每个事件读到的内容不一样：

Hook 读到什么 SessionStart session_id、cwd UserPromptSubmit prompt PreToolUse tool、params PostToolUse tool、params、result Stop last_message SessionEnd session_id、turns、cost

docs.title: hook 怎么回答
docs.text:
hook 从标准输入读这些细节，把答案写成 JSON 写到标准输出：

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import sys

payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
if payload.get("tool") == "bash" and "rm -rf" in payload["params"].get("command", ""):
    print(json.dumps({"decision": "deny", "reason": "that command is not allowed"}))

可以写的键：

  • decision：allow、deny 或 block。只有 deny 和 block 会被看—— allow 什么也不做：它既不会批准这次调用，也不会跳过权限检查。
  • reason：为什么。它会作为工具的错误回到模型那里。
  • additionalContext：给模型看的一句话。
  • updatedInput：这一刻的新输入。PreToolUse 里它是一个映射，替换掉工具的参数； UserPromptSubmit 里它是一个字符串，替换掉用户的提问。PostToolUse 里工具已经跑完了， 给映射也换不了什么。

标准输出是空的，意思就是这个 hook 没有意见。几个 hook 的答案会合并起来：deny 压过其他一切，上下文拼在一起，updatedInput 取最后一个。

docs.title: 答案会做什么
docs.text:
答案 会发生什么 PreToolUse 拒绝 这次工具调用失败，理由回到模型那里 PreToolUse 改写参数 工具用新的参数跑 PreToolUse 允许 什么也不发生。权限检查照旧 PostToolUse 拒绝 回给模型的那条消息变成一个错误，日志里工具的结果照旧 PostToolUse 补上下文 上下文追加到工具的结果后面 UserPromptSubmit 拒绝 这一轮以错误结束，模型根本不被调用 UserPromptSubmit 补上下文 上下文追加到提问后面 UserPromptSubmit 改写提问 模型看到的是新提问，日志里两个都留着 Stop 拒绝 agent 接着干，理由作为一条新消息给它（每轮最多三次）

PreToolUse 的 hook 跑在权限检查之前，所以被批准的是被改写之后的那条命令。

docs.title: 一个改写提问的 hook
docs.text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json
import sys

payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(json.dumps({"updatedInput": payload["prompt"] + "\n\n用中文回答。"}))

模型从头到尾看不到用户原话，只看到改写后的那份。事件日志里存的是模型看到的那份， 这样重放这个会话时说的一样的话；用户原话放在同一条记录的 original 里。网页版里， 气泡显示用户写的话，下面一行小字说明给 agent 的是什么。

PreToolUse 的 hook 如果回答一个字符串 updatedInput，什么也不会发生：只有映射 才能替换工具的参数。

docs.title: hook 失败的时候
docs.text:
hook 崩了、超时了，或者写出来的东西不是 JSON，都会被忽略：操作照旧进行。

strict: true 只改一件事：以非零退出码结束的 hook 会拦住这次操作，它的标准错误 就是理由。超时和坏掉的答案两种情况下都被忽略。

docs.title: MCP servers
docs.text:
The coding agent can use the tools of an MCP server. The MCP SDK is optional:

pip install "mini-swe-agent[mcp]"

docs.title: The configuration
docs.text:
mcp:
  timeout: 30
  servers:
    - name: filesystem
      command: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /path/to/the/project
      env:
        LOG_LEVEL: info

The servers are read from the project file .coderagent/config.yaml and from the user file ~/.coderagent/config.yaml. The two lists are not added together: the list of the user replaces the list of the project.

Key What it is name The name of the server. It is part of the name of its tools command The command that starts the server, over the standard input and output env The environment of the server enabled false skips the server url The address of the server, for the http transport. Ignored today headers The headers of the http transport. Ignored today

The timeout is not a key of a server: it belongs to mcp, next to servers, and it is how long the agent waits for a server.

Only the standard input and output transport works today. A server with a url and no command is skipped: the http transport is not implemented yet. url and headers are accepted by the configuration but have no effect — nothing reads them.

The env of a server is added to the environment it inherits, it does not replace it: the server keeps PATH, HOME and the rest of the variables the MCP SDK passes on, and the ones of the configuration win over them.

mcp:
  servers:
    - name: filesystem
      command: npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem .
      env:
        LOG_LEVEL: info

docs.title: What the tools look like
docs.text:
The tools of a server are named mcp__<server>__<tool>, so they never clash with the built-in tools. The schema of the tool is the schema of the server.

mcp__filesystem__read_file
mcp__filesystem__list_directory

The tools of a server are external code, so they go through the permission layer like every other tool: in the default mode the user has to approve them. A rule that allows one for good looks like this:

# .coderagent/rules.yaml
rules:
  - tool: "mcp__filesystem__read_file"
    pattern: "*"
    decision: allow

The name of the tool is the whole name, with the server in it. The pattern is * or the same name: a glob does not work here.

docs.title: The servers and the session
docs.text:
The servers are started when the session starts, one thread each. A server that does not start is skipped, the reason is in the log and /mcp shows it. The other servers keep working.

/mcp

filesystem       connected
remote           not connected
broken           failed: MCPError: Connection closed

not connected is a server that was never started: it has no command, so the http transport would be needed and it is not implemented yet. failed is a server that was started and did not come up.

When a call breaks the connection, the agent reconnects and tries the call one more time. When it fails again, the error goes back to the model.

docs.title: The memory
docs.text: The agent remembers two kinds of things: what it learned about the project and what the user likes. The first is written by the agent, the second only after the user says so.

docs.title: What the agent reads
docs.text:
Everything below goes into the context of the model, before the conversation, in this order:

Where What it is ~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md The instructions and the preferences of the user AGENTS.md The instructions of the project CLAUDE.md The instructions of the project .coderagent/memory/*.md What the agent learned about the project ~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md The preferences of the user

An AGENTS.md in a subdirectory is read when the agent touches something in it, and not before.

The file of the user is read twice: once as the instructions of the user, and once as the memory of the user. The preferences that /memory confirm writes are therefore read at the start of the next session.

The project memory is every markdown file of .coderagent/memory/, so you may write conventions.md or architecture.md next to the file the agent keeps for itself.

docs.title: What the agent writes
docs.text:
When a session ends, the model is asked what is worth remembering for the sessions that come after it. A session ends when the interface is closed, when /clear starts a new one, and at the end of a run of coder --task .... It answers with two lists:

{
  "project_facts": ["The tests of the parser run with `pytest -m slow`"],
  "user_preferences": ["The comments of the user are in Chinese"]
}

The project facts are objective things about the project that are not in the code and not in the instructions. They are written right away, into .coderagent/memory/projects.md:

# Project memory

- The tests of the parser run with `pytest -m slow`

The user preferences are how the user likes to work. They go into the instructions of every session, so a wrong one is expensive. They wait for a confirmation:

# Preferences waiting for a confirmation

- The comments of the user are in Chinese

That file is .coderagent/pending-memory.md.

docs.title: The commands
docs.text:
/memory                # the memory of the project, the pending preferences, the memory of the user
/memory confirm        # write the pending preferences to ~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md
/memory forget <text>  # remove a line from the project memory or from the pending file

/memory confirm moves the pending preferences into ~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md, under a heading of their own:

## Preferences

- The comments of the user are in Chinese

/memory forget takes the text of the line to remove. It works on the project memory and on the pending file, not on the file of the user.

docs.title: The rules
docs.text:
• A fact that is already there is not written twice. The comparison ignores the case and the punctuation.
  • The project memory does not grow past 200 lines. The pending file has the same limit. When it would, nothing is written and the agent says so in the log: the file has to be tidied up first.
  • The preferences of the user are never written without the confirmation.
  • The project facts are written without a confirmation: they are about the project, and the user can change them like any other file.

docs.title: The cost
docs.text:
The reflection is a model call like any other. It is not part of a turn, so it is not in the cost of a turn, but it is in the bill of the session: it lands in the event log, and session_cost, /cost and coder export count it.

A turn that failed or that ran out of the money budget is not settled: there is nothing to remember, and no money to do it. A turn that stopped at the token limit is settled like any other.

docs.title: Turning it off
docs.text:
memory:
  enabled: false

The model is not even asked, and the memory of the project and of the user is not put into the context of the model any more. The path of the project file is yours to change, the path of the user file only in its file name — it is always written into the directory of the user:

memory:
  project_path: ".coderagent/memory"
  user_path: "~/.coderagent/CLAUDE.md"

The file with the preferences that wait for a confirmation is always <cwd>/.coderagent/pending-memory.md.

docs.title: Plugins
docs.text:
A plugin adds tools, commands, hooks or model backends to the agent. A plugin is a directory with a plugin.py in it:

.coderagent/plugins/hello/
└── plugin.py

The plugin runs in the process of the agent, without a sandbox. It is only loaded when the user has trusted it.

The code of a plugin is not run before that decision. Finding the plugins only reads their source, to see whether they have a register; the module is imported when a trusted plugin is loaded. So /plugins never runs the code of a plugin, and an untrusted plugin cannot do anything but sit on the disk.

docs.title: Where a plugin is looked for
docs.text:
Where What ~/.coderagent/plugins/*/ The plugins of the user .coderagent/plugins/*/ The plugins of the project The entry point group coderagent.plugins The plugins that are installed with pip

The name of a plugin is the name of its directory. A plugin of the project and a plugin of the user with the same name are both loaded: the name is only the name of the plugin, the trust is remembered by that name.

docs.title: Trusting a plugin
docs.text:
/plugins            # the plugins that were found, and what the user answered for them
/plugins trust hello

A plugin that was not trusted is never loaded, and nothing is asked: the answer comes from /plugins trust. The answer is remembered in ~/.coderagent/trusted-plugins.json (MSWEA_CODER_HOME moves it), so it is given once and holds for every session.

hello            trusted      directory
other            not trusted  directory

The last column says where the plugin came from: a directory, or an entry point of an installed package.

A plugin that the user refused stays away until the name is trusted again. The trust is by name, so it holds for the plugin of the project and for the plugin of the user that have the same name.

docs.title: The API of a plugin
docs.text:
The plugin file has a register function. The function gets the extension registry:

# .coderagent/plugins/hello/plugin.py
from coderagent.tools.base import ToolResult
from coderagent.ui.commands import Command


class HelloTool:
    name = "hello"
    description = "Say hello to the user."

    parameters = {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}}}

    def run(self, params, ctx):
        return ToolResult(f"Hello, {params.get('name', 'there')}!")


def hello(context, argument):
    context.say("Hello!")


def register(registry):
    registry.tools.register(HelloTool())
    registry.commands.append(Command(name="hello", description="Say hello", handler=hello))

The registry has four parts:

Part What it is registry.tools The tools the model may call registry.commands The slash commands the user may type registry.hooks The hooks, in the format of the configuration registry.model_backends The model backends, by name

The tools, the commands and the hooks are used by the agent. The model backends are not wired yet: a plugin may fill the table, but the agent does not read it.

A tool that the plugin registers goes through the same permission check as the tools of the agent, so the rules of the project apply to it as well.

A command that the plugin registers works like a built-in one: the user types /hello, and the handler gets the context of the session and the text of the line.

docs.title: Writing a plugin that is installed with pip
docs.text:
# pyproject.toml
[project.entry-points."coderagent.plugins"]
hello = "hello_plugin:plugin"

The object the entry point points at is loaded a little more loosely: it is either a register function or an object with a register method. A plugin.py has to use the function — a class with a register method is found by the search, but it is not loaded afterwards and the plugin stays empty. The one exception is a class whose name is exactly plugin: it is loaded like the function would be.

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text:
本页用最短的路径把 coder（本仓库里的交互式 coding agent）跑起来，并说明日常怎么用它。

  • 安装
  • 配置模型和 API key
  • 第一次会话
  • 也可以在浏览器里跑
  • 不用终端的用法
  • 权限：agent 改文件前要问你
  • 常用命令
  • 给项目写一份配置
  • 扩展：子 agent、skills、命令
  • 会话与花费
  • 常见问题

docs.title: 安装
docs.text:
从源码装（要改代码就用这个）：

git clone https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent.git
cd mini-swe-agent
pip install -e .

装完有两个命令：

命令 是什么 coder 交互式 coding agent，本页的主角 mini mini-swe-agent 本体，跑 SWE-bench 之类的任务

可选依赖：

pip install -e ".[mcp]"    # MCP 服务器
pip install -e ".[full]"   # 沙箱（swerex / modal / contree）等一切

docs.title: 配置模型和 API key
docs.text:
模型走 litellm，所以任何 litellm 支持的模型都能用，只要带上厂商前缀（anthropic/…、deepseek/…）。

API key 从环境变量读，名字就是厂商的名字：ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、OPENAI_API_KEY、DEEPSEEK_API_KEY、OPENROUTER_API_KEY……完整列表见模型配置。

有三种写法，任选一种：

# 1. 写进全局 .env（推荐，一次搞定，所有会话都能用）
mini-extra config set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY sk-...
mini-extra config set MSWEA_MODEL_NAME anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5

# 2. 当前 shell 的环境变量（重启 shell 就没了）
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-...
export MSWEA_MODEL_NAME=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5

# 3. 命令行直接指定
coder -m deepseek/deepseek-flash --task "..."

全局 .env 在 mini-extra config edit 打印的那个路径（macOS 上是 ~/Library/Application Support/mini-swe-agent/.env）。

模型的优先级是：配置文件里的 model.model_name > 环境变量 MSWEA_MODEL_NAME > 内置默认值。 没配置时默认用 anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5。

docs.title: 换别的厂商
docs.text:
litellm 支持的模型都能用，模型名里带厂商前缀，key 从同名环境变量读：

模型名 厂商 环境变量 anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 Anthropic ANTHROPIC_API_KEY openai/gpt-4o OpenAI OPENAI_API_KEY deepseek/deepseek-flash DeepSeek DEEPSEEK_API_KEY dashscope/qwen3-coder-plus 阿里（DashScope） DASHSCOPE_API_KEY moonshot/kimi-k2.5 月之暗面 MOONSHOT_API_KEY minimax/minimax-m2 MiniMax MINIMAX_API_KEY（外加 MINIMAX_API_BASE） openrouter/qwen/qwen3-coder OpenRouter OPENROUTER_API_KEY 
export DASHSCOPE_API_KEY=sk-...
coder -m dashscope/qwen3-coder-plus --task "..."

export MOONSHOT_API_KEY=sk-...
coder -m moonshot/kimi-k2.5 --task "..."

export MINIMAX_API_KEY=...
export MINIMAX_API_BASE=https://api.minimax.io/v1
coder -m minimax/minimax-m2 --task "..."

三个坑：

  • qwen/ 不是厂商。 千问在 dashscope/ 下（qwen_ai_platform/ 是它的旧名）。qwen/ 是模型系列的名字，不是路由。
  • 上下文窗口按模型名查表：qwen 32k、deepseek 64k、kimi 256k、minimax 200k、claude 200k、gpt- 128k、gemini 1M。遇到新模型或表里没有的系列，自己写：context.context_window: 262144。
  • 模型必须支持工具调用（tool calling），否则用不了。系列里的小模型常常不支持，只在 model.routing.cheap 里用它们。

混用厂商时用路由分层：主力模型干活，便宜模型做杂活。

model:
  model_name: dashscope/qwen3-coder-plus
  routing:
    cheap: moonshot/kimi-k2.5
    summarize: moonshot/kimi-k2.5

docs.title: 第一次会话
docs.text:
cd my-project
coder

界面顶部是状态栏：模型、上下文用量、本次会话花了多少钱、当前目录、沙箱、权限模式。

直接说人话就行：

fix the failing test in tests/test_parser.py

agent 会自己读代码、改文件、跑测试。写入文件前它会先存一个 checkpoint，可以用 /rewind 退回去。

docs.title: 也可以在浏览器里跑
docs.text:
pip install -e ".[web]"
coder web

同一个 agent，在浏览器里跑：聊天页是终端界面的窗口版，设置页可以把模型和 API key 配好（API key 只写进用户级的 ~/.coderagent/config.yaml，永远不明文回浏览器）。

注意没有认证：能访问端口的人就能驱动 agent 在当前目录里跑命令，所以默认只听 127.0.0.1。详见网页版（English）。

docs.title: 不用终端的用法
docs.text:
CI、脚本、或者只有一条消息要问的时候：

coder --task "fix the failing test in tests/test_parser.py"

输出是对话加一行本轮的账：

[stop_reason=end_turn cost=0.0016 session_cost=0.0019 session=20261106-a1b2c3]

cost 是这一轮，session_cost 是整个会话。要机器读就加 --output-format json：

{
  "session_id": "20261106-a1b2c3",
  "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "The test needed a fixture."}],
  "cost": 0.0016,
  "session_cost": 0.0019,
  "stop_reason": "end_turn",
  "error": ""
}

stop_reason 有七种：end_turn、max_turns、cost_exceeded、token_limit、verify_failed、interrupted、error。

没有终端就没人能批准操作，所以默认模式下需要批准的调用一律被拒（模型只会看到「用户拒绝了」，看不到拒绝的理由，模型会换个做法）。 脚本里如果确实需要它动手，加 --permission-mode bypass：

coder --task "..." --permission-mode bypass

docs.title: 权限：agent 改文件前要问你
docs.text:
五种模式，--permission-mode 或者会话里 /mode 切换：

模式 行为 default 读随便读，写文件和跑命令要问你 acceptEdits 写文件不问，跑命令要问你 plan 只读不改，agent 只看不碰 readonly 同 plan，但 agent 被告知只描述改动、不动手 bypass 全放行。只在容器或一次性 checkout 里用

plan 和 readonly 让权限层拒掉写文件的工具，所以模型会被告知这件事：一段 <permission_mode mode="..."> 的说明会进到对话里，说清楚它现在能做什么、 应该改成回答什么。模式一变，这段说明也跟着变。

界面里被问到的时候：y 允许这一次，n 拒绝，a 永远允许——它会把一条规则写进 ~/.coderagent/rules.yaml，以后这个文件（或这条命令）都放行，所有会话都算。 选项是一行一个、带编号的方框，选中的那个是红星 [*]，没选的是灰杠 [-]：

1 [*] y allow
2 [-] n deny
3 [-] a always allow

方向键（←/→ 或 ↑/↓）移动选中项，数字键直接跳到那一项，回车确认。 拒绝会回到模型，模型会改主意而不是硬来。

想固定某些规则，写在 .coderagent/rules.yaml（项目）和 ~/.coderagent/rules.yaml（用户）：

rules:
  - tool: bash
    pattern: "pytest"
    decision: allow
  - tool: edit
    pattern: "tests/**"
    decision: allow

decision 是 allow / ask / deny：路径类工具最后一条匹配上的规则赢， 命令则是分段判断、最严的那段说了算。

docs.title: 常用命令
docs.text:
会话里以 / 开头的是命令，其余都是给 agent 的话。常用的几个：

命令 作用 /help 所有命令的列表 /plan 切成只读模式，先让它给出方案 /mode 看/切权限模式 /cost 这次会话花了多少钱，花在哪 /diff 看工作区的改动 /init 给项目写一份模板 AGENTS.md（不问模型） /todos agent 的任务清单 /clear 开一个新会话（账从 0 开始） /rewind 看 checkpoint，指定 id 就退回去 /status 会话的状态 /context 上下文用了多少

完整列表在 /help 的输出里。

docs.title: 给项目写一份配置
docs.text:
在项目根目录放 .coderagent/config.yaml，四层配置里它排第二（后面还有用户级的 ~/.coderagent/config.yaml 和命令行的 -c key=value，越靠后越优先）：

model:
  model_name: deepseek/deepseek-flash
  routing:
    cheap: deepseek/deepseek-flash
    summarize: deepseek/deepseek-flash

agent:
  max_turns: 50
  cost_limit: 5.0

tools:
  enabled: [read, write, edit, glob, grep, ls, bash, todo_write]
  bash_timeout: 120

permissions:
  mode: default
  deny_paths: ["*.env", "secrets/**"]

context:
  context_window: 64000
  compact_threshold: 0.8

memory:
  enabled: true

sandbox:
  type: local

每个键的完整说明在配置总览。

tools.enabled 是白名单，会替换默认列表

默认的工具是 read, write, edit, multi_edit, glob, grep, ls, bash, bash_output, bash_kill, todo_write, task, skill。 你一旦写了 tools.enabled，没列进去的工具就没了——上面的例子会去掉 multi_edit、task（子 agent）和 skill。 想减工具用 tools.disabled，它只拿走你点名的那些。

命令行临时改一个键：

coder -c model.model_name=deepseek/deepseek-flash -c permissions.mode=plan

docs.title: 扩展：子 agent、skills、命令
docs.text:
三样东西都在项目的 .coderagent/ 下：

.coderagent/
├── config.yaml       # 配置
├── rules.yaml        # 权限规则
├── agents/*.md       # 子 agent：独立上下文干一件活
├── skills/*/SKILL.md # skill：带脚本和资源的可复用能力包
├── commands/*.md     # 自定义命令
└── memory/           # agent 记住的项目事实

子 agent 适合「全仓找某个符号」这种会把主上下文撑爆的活：

---
name: doc-writer
description: 给一个模块写文档。
tools: [read, grep, glob]
model_purpose: cheap
max_turns: 15
---
你是模块文档专家，先读代码再写文档。

自定义命令是给用户用的 /name：

---
description: 生成提交信息
argument-hint: [file]
---
描述 $1 的改动。

细节见子 agent、skills、命令。

docs.title: 会话与花费
docs.text:
每个会话是一份只追加的事件日志，它是唯一的事实来源，存在 ~/.coderagent/sessions/。

coder --list              # 这个目录的会话
coder --resume <id>       # 接着聊
coder --fork <id>         # 复制一份再接着聊
coder export --session <id> --format json --out trace.json
coder export --session <id> --format otel --out trace.otlp

账是每个会话自己的：/clear 之后的新会话从 0 开始，不会背着上一段会话的账。cost_limit 也是每个会话的预算。

/cost、/status 和 coder export 报的是同一个数字。

docs.title: 常见问题
docs.text:
「找不到 API key」 key 必须在环境变量里，或者在 mini-extra config edit 打印的那个 .env 里。 coder 启动时会读这个 .env（启动横幅会打印它的路径，想安静就设 MSWEA_SILENT_STARTUP=1），读不到就报认证错误。 查一下当前进程里到底有没有：

python -c "import coderagent.ui.cli, os; print(os.getenv('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'))"

「改了文件但我没同意」 默认模式下写文件要批准，界面里按 y 允许这一次、a 永远允许（会写一条规则进 ~/.coderagent/rules.yaml）。或者用 /mode acceptEdits。脚本里用 --permission-mode bypass。

「agent 一直问我要批准」 在 .coderagent/rules.yaml 里放一条规则，把这个工具定成 allow。

「上下文满了 / 越聊越慢」 上下文到窗口的 compact_threshold（默认 0.8）就会自动压缩，把老的部分换成摘要。也可以随时 /compact。用 /context 看用量。

「上一轮改的东西怎么找回来」 /rewind 看 checkpoint，带 id 就把文件和对话一起退回去。默认保留最近 50 个（checkpoint.keep）。

「想换个模型」 会话里 /model <名字>，或者 coder -m <名字>。也可以在配置里写 model.routing，让压缩、总结、子 agent 各自用便宜的模型。

「agent 好像忘了项目的事」 会话结束时它会把值得记的事实写进 .coderagent/memory/projects.md。用 /memory 看。也可以直接写 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md，agent 开工前会读。

「怎么知道它干了什么、花了多少钱」 coder export --session <id> --format json --out trace.json 导出完整轨迹和指标；/cost 看实时账。

docs.title: The model routing
docs.text: The agent does not always need the same model. The summary of a compacted context, the reflection at the end of a session and a sub agent that looks for a symbol do not need the strongest model you have, and the model that answers the main loop should get stronger when the job gets big.

docs.title: The purposes
docs.text:
A purpose is a job, not a model. The routing says which model does which job:

model:
  model_name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
  routing:
    main: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
    cheap: deepseek/deepseek-flash
    summarize: deepseek/deepseek-flash
    reflect: deepseek/deepseek-flash
    strong: anthropic/claude-opus-4-1
Purpose What it is for main The agent itself cheap The small jobs: the sub agents that look around summarize The summary of a compacted context reflect What the session writes into the memory strong A stronger model, when the job is big

A purpose that is not routed uses the model of the main loop.

The summary has a setting of its own, which wins over the routing:

context:
  summarize_model: deepseek/deepseek-flash

docs.title: The rules of the main loop
docs.text:
Without any rule the routing follows a policy of its own:

The state of the session What happens The budget is 80% used A cheaper model takes over The token budget is 80% used A cheaper model takes over The context is over 50k tokens A stronger model takes over The session is over 30 turns A stronger model takes over

The budget is agent.cost_limit and the token budget is agent.token_limit. A model without a price spends no money, so the token budget is the budget that counts for it.

A stronger model only takes over when routing.strong is set. A cheaper one only takes over when routing.cheap is set.

docs.title: Your own rules
docs.text:
A rule is a condition on the state of the session, and the purpose it leads to:

model:
  routing:
    strong: anthropic/claude-opus-4-1
  routing_rules:
    - when: "tokens > 50000"
      purpose: strong
    - when: "calls > 20"
      purpose: cheap

The condition is a number, an operator and a number:

<key> <operator> <number>

The operators are >, >=, <, <=, == and !=. The keys are the state of the session:

Key What it is tokens The size of the context turns The turns of the session calls The model calls of the session cost What the session has cost so far budget The cost limit of the session tokens_used The tokens the session has used token_budget The token limit of the session

The rules are parsed, not evaluated. A condition that is not of that form never holds, and it never runs code: a configuration file cannot make the agent do anything.

The rules are tried before the purpose of the call, and before the policy of the main loop. The first rule that holds wins.

docs.title: What the user sees
docs.text:
The status bar shows the model of the moment. When the model changes, a message comes into the conversation of the interface:

Switched from deepseek/deepseek-flash to anthropic/claude-opus-4-1: the context has grown

The reason is one of these: the budget is nearly used up, the token budget is nearly used up, the context has grown, the session has many turns, or the rule that held. In the trace the change is a state_change event, with the model, the previous one and the reason.

docs.title: Changing the model by hand
docs.text:
/model                # the model of the session and the routing
/model deepseek/deepseek-chat

A model that the user picked wins over every rule. It changes the model of the main loop; the other purposes keep their routing.

docs.title: The money
docs.text:
The routing looks at the budget of the session, not at the total of the process. A new session starts at zero, so it is not punished for what the session before it spent.

The cost of a model that runs on another model is booked on the main one, so the budget of the session holds every call, whatever purpose it was made for.

docs.title: The sandbox
docs.text:
The commands of the agent run in a sandbox. By default the sandbox is the machine of the user.

sandbox:
  type: local

docs.title: The remote sandboxes
docs.text:
The sandboxes of mini-swe-agent are used as they are:

sandbox.type What it does local The commands run on this machine docker A Docker container singularity A Singularity container swerex_docker A Docker container that SWE-ReX manages swerex_modal A container on Modal bubblewrap A sandbox without root contree A container without root 
sandbox:
  type: swerex_docker
  image: python:3.11

The options that the environment does not know are ignored, so the same configuration works for every kind of sandbox. A full path of a class works as well, which is the way to use an environment of your own:

sandbox:
  type: my_package.my_module.MyEnvironment

The credentials of the remote sandboxes (SWE_REX_SERVER_URL, SWE_REX_API_KEY, …) come from the environment or from the .env file.

The container works in its own directory, not in the directory of the session: the path of the host does not exist in a container. Give the container a directory of its own with the cwd option:

sandbox:
  type: swerex_docker
  image: python:3.11
  cwd: /workspace

docs.title: What the interface shows
docs.text:
The bar at the top of the interface names the sandbox when it is not the local one, and /sandbox shows the whole configuration:

type: swerex_docker
image: python:3.11
environment: swerex_docker

The options that are in effect are listed between the type and the environment.

docs.title: The sandbox has no policy of its own
docs.text:
The sandbox is the environment of mini-swe-agent, so it has no network policy and no list of writable directories. A network policy is a property of the environment, and it is written there — with the options that the environment knows. The docker sandbox takes the arguments of the docker command:

sandbox:
  type: docker
  image: python:3.11
  run_args: ["--rm", "--network", "none"]

Every sandbox has its own options: the swerex_docker one, for instance, takes deployment_extra_kwargs for the deployment of SWE-ReX. The options that the environment does not know are ignored, so a run_args under swerex_docker is dropped without a word.

The paths the agent may touch are a property of the agent, not of the sandbox. They are bounded by the permission layer: permissions.deny_paths for the paths that are off limits and permissions.include_dirs for the ones outside the directory of the session that are allowed.

A configuration that still has sandbox.network or sandbox.writable_roots keeps working: they are unknown options now, and unknown options are ignored.

docs.title: What is still local
docs.text:
The tools that read and write files (read, write, edit, …) work on the files of the machine of the user, because the environment of mini-swe-agent only runs commands. Only the commands of the bash tool go into the sandbox.

The magic of mini-swe-agent, where a command that prints COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT ends the task, is switched off in the remote sandboxes as well: a turn of the coding agent ends when the model says so.

docs.title: Skills
docs.text:
A skill is a package of instructions, scripts and resources for a kind of task that comes back often.

.coderagent/skills/pdf-report/
├── SKILL.md
├── scripts/
│   └── make_report.py
└── assets/
    └── template.docx

The SKILL.md says what the skill is for. The model sees the name and the description of every skill, and loads the whole one when the description fits the task:

---
name: pdf-report
description: Make a PDF report out of a folder of notes.
---
Run `scripts/make_report.py` to build the report:

    python scripts/make_report.py notes/ --template assets/template.docx

The report lands in `report.pdf`.
Field What it is Default name The name of the skill The name of the directory description What it is for, and when to use it

The body is the instruction that the model reads when it loads the skill. A file without a front matter is ignored.

docs.title: Where a skill is looked for
docs.text:
Where What .coderagent/skills/*/SKILL.md The skills of the project ~/.coderagent/skills/*/SKILL.md The skills of the user

The project comes last, so a project may replace a skill of the user with the same name. MSWEA_CODER_HOME moves the directory of the user.

/skills lists them:

pdf-report       Make a PDF report out of a folder of notes.
                 /path/to/project/.coderagent/skills/pdf-report

docs.title: How the model uses a skill
docs.text:
The index of the skills goes into the system prompt, so the model knows what is on the table without paying for it:

<skills>
These skills are available. Load one with the `skill` tool when its description fits the task.
- pdf-report: Make a PDF report out of a folder of notes.
</skills>

When the task fits, the model calls the skill tool with the name. The tool gives back the body of the SKILL.md and the path of the directory, so the model knows where the scripts are. The scripts themselves are run with bash, in the working directory of the session.

A skill is a package of steps, not a program: the model reads the instructions and follows them, and the scripts are only there to make the steps easier.

docs.title: A skill and a command
docs.text:
A skill A command Who calls it The model, when the description fits The user, with /name What it is Instructions the model follows A message the user sends What it leaves Files, reports, commits A message in the conversation

A command is in .coderagent/commands/*.md, see The commands. A skill is in .coderagent/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

docs.title: The permissions
docs.text:
The skill tool is a tool that is asked for, like bash. Without a terminal nobody can answer, so in a script the call is refused:

coder --task "..." --permission-mode bypass

or a rule of your own:

# .coderagent/rules.yaml
rules:
  - tool: skill
    pattern: "*"
    decision: allow

docs.title: Sub agents
docs.text:
中文版：子 agent

A sub agent is a job that runs in its own context and returns a conclusion.

The main agent reads the code, but a job like "find every place this pattern occurs" fills the context with output that nobody reads again. A sub agent does that job in a context of its own, and the main agent gets the conclusion:

main agent calls `task`
  → the sub agent gets its own system prompt and its own prompt
  → the sub agent works with a white list of tools
  → the sub agent ends
  → the main agent gets the conclusion, not the whole story

The sub agent cannot see the conversation of the main agent. Whatever it needs has to be in the prompt of the call.

docs.title: The three that are always there
docs.text:
Name What it does Tools Purpose Turns code-explorer Find code: locate a symbol, follow a call chain read grep glob ls cheap 15 verifier Check a result on its own: run the tests, reproduce the bug read grep glob bash main 20 refactorer Change the same pattern everywhere read edit grep glob main 30

/agents lists them, with the tools of each one and the turns it may really make:

code-explorer    cheap  read, grep, glob, ls  (15 turns)
                 Find code: locate a symbol, follow a call chain, explain how a part works.
verifier         main   read, grep, glob, bash  (20 turns)
                 Check a result on its own: run the tests, reproduce the bug.

The turns in brackets are the ones that count: the ceiling of the configuration holds them down (see The limits).

docs.title: Writing your own
docs.text:
A sub agent is a markdown file. The front matter says what it is, the body is its system prompt:

---
name: doc-writer
description: Write the documentation of a module.
tools: [read, grep, glob]
model_purpose: cheap
max_turns: 15
---
You write the documentation of a module. Read the code, then write the docs.
Field What it is Default name The name of the sub agent The name of the file, without the extension description What it is for. The main agent reads this one tools The tools it may call. A list, or a comma separated string read grep glob bash model_purpose Which model answers for it cheap max_turns How many model calls it may make. 0 means no limit 20

The tools are a white list: the sub agent cannot reach anything that is not on it. A file without a front matter is ignored.

docs.title: The limits
docs.text:
A sub agent has its own turn budget, and the session has a ceiling over all of them.

Where What it changes max_turns in the front matter How many model calls this sub agent may make agent.subagent_max_turns The ceiling over every sub agent. 0 means no ceiling agent.subagent_max_parallel How many sub agents may run at the same time. 2 by default, 0 means no limit

The ceiling wins over the front matter: a sub agent that asks for 30 turns runs 20 of them when agent.subagent_max_turns is 20. A sub agent may always ask for fewer.

The parallel limit is about the provider, not about the money: a model that fires four task calls in one answer would otherwise run four sub agents at the same time, and the provider may answer with a rate limit. The others wait for a free slot — they are not refused.

# ~/.coderagent/config.yaml
agent:
  subagent_max_turns: 20
  subagent_max_parallel: 2

The turns of a sub agent are not the turns of the main agent: they do not count towards agent.max_turns. The money is shared, though — the cost of a sub agent is part of the bill of the session, so cost_limit and token_limit hold it.

docs.title: Where a sub agent is looked for
docs.text:
Where What .coderagent/agents/*.md The sub agents of the project ~/.coderagent/agents/*.md The sub agents of the user

The project comes last, so a project may replace a sub agent of the user with the same name. MSWEA_CODER_HOME moves the directory of the user.

docs.title: The result
docs.text:
The task tool returns a JSON object:

{
  "status": "completed",
  "summary": "The parser lives in src/parser.py and is called by the CLI.",
  "findings": ["src/parser.py:42 parses the arguments"],
  "files_touched": [],
  "cost": 0.031,
  "tokens_in": 12043,
  "tokens_out": 987,
  "turns": 7,
  "purpose": "cheap"
}
Field What it is status completed, max_turns or error summary The last thing the sub agent said. This is the conclusion findings The bullet points of that conclusion files_touched The files it changed. The files it read are not in it cost What it spent tokens_in The tokens it sent tokens_out The tokens it got back turns How many model calls it made purpose The purpose of the model that answered for it

status is max_turns when the sub agent ran out of turns before it was done, and error when its model failed. An error comes back to the main agent as a failed call, so it knows the answer is not trustworthy.

The money of the sub agent is the money of the session: it is part of the bill of the session, and of cost_limit. When the sub agent runs on its own model (model_purpose is routed to a different model), its cost is booked on the main model, so the budget of the session still holds it.

docs.title: The permissions
docs.text:
The tools of the sub agent go through the same permission layer as the tools of the main agent. In plan mode a sub agent cannot write either.

They go through the same hooks too: a PreToolUse hook that blocks a tool blocks it for the sub agent as well, and a file a sub agent writes is checkpointed like a file of the main agent, so /rewind can bring it back. The result of every tool of a sub agent lands in the event log of the session.

The task tool itself is a tool that is asked for, like bash. Without a terminal nobody can answer, so in a script the call is refused:

coder --task "..." --permission-mode bypass

or a rule of your own:

# .coderagent/rules.yaml
rules:
  - tool: task
    pattern: "*"
    decision: allow

docs.title: 子 agent
docs.text:
子 agent 是一件在自己的上下文里干完、然后交回一个结论的活。

主 agent 读代码，但像「找出这个模式出现的所有地方」这种活会把上下文塞满没人再看 一遍的输出。子 agent 在自己的上下文里干这件事，主 agent 拿到的是结论：

主 agent 调用 `task`
  → 子 agent 拿到自己的系统提示词和自己的 prompt
  → 子 agent 用一份工具白名单干活
  → 子 agent 结束
  → 主 agent 拿到结论，不是整个过程

子 agent 看不见主 agent 的对话。它需要什么，都得写在这次调用的 prompt 里。

英文版：Sub agents

docs.title: 自带的三个
docs.text:
名字 干什么 工具 用途 轮数 code-explorer 找代码：定位一个符号，追一条调用链 read grep glob ls cheap 15 verifier 自己验一遍结果：跑测试，复现 bug read grep glob bash main 20 refactorer 把同一个模式改到所有该改的地方 read edit grep glob main 30

/agents 会列出它们，还有每个的工具和真正生效的轮数：

code-explorer    cheap  read, grep, glob, ls  (15 turns)
                 Find code: locate a symbol, follow a call chain, explain how a part works.
verifier         main   read, grep, glob, bash  (20 turns)
                 Check a result on its own: run the tests, reproduce the bug.

括号里的是算数的轮数：配置里的天花板会把它压下来（见限制）。

docs.title: 自己写一个
docs.text:
子 agent 是一个 markdown 文件。front matter 说明它是什么，正文是它的系统提示词：

---
name: doc-writer
description: Write the documentation of a module.
tools: [read, grep, glob]
model_purpose: cheap
max_turns: 15
---
You write the documentation of a module. Read the code, then write the docs.
字段 是什么 默认值 name 子 agent 的名字 文件名（不带扩展名） description 它干什么用。主 agent 读的是这一条 tools 它能调的工具。一个列表，或者逗号隔开的字符串 read grep glob bash model_purpose 用哪个模型替它回答 cheap max_turns 它最多能调几次模型。0 表示不限 20

工具是白名单：白名单上没有的，子 agent 够不着。没有 front matter 的文件会被 忽略。

docs.title: 限制
docs.text:
子 agent 有自己的轮数预算，会话还有一个压在所有子 agent 的头上的天花板。

在哪 改什么 front matter 里的 max_turns 这个子 agent 最多能调几次模型 agent.subagent_max_turns 所有子 agent 的天花板。0 表示不设天花板 agent.subagent_max_parallel 同时最多跑几个子 agent。默认 2，0 表示不限

天花板压过 front matter：agent.subagent_max_turns 是 20 时，一个要 30 轮的子 agent 只跑 20 轮。反过来，子 agent 总是可以要更少的。

并行的那个限制是给厂商看的，不是给钱看的：模型一次回答里发四个 task，就会 同时跑四个子 agent，厂商可能回一个限流。剩下的等空位——不会被拒。

# ~/.coderagent/config.yaml
agent:
  subagent_max_turns: 20
  subagent_max_parallel: 2

子 agent 的轮数不算主 agent 的轮数：它们不占 agent.max_turns。但钱是共享 的——子 agent 的花费算在这个会话的账单里，所以 cost_limit 和 token_limit 照样 管得住它。

docs.title: 子 agent 在哪里找
docs.text:
哪里 什么 .coderagent/agents/*.md 项目的子 agent ~/.coderagent/agents/*.md 用户的子 agent

项目排在后面，所以项目可以用同名的东西盖掉用户的那个。MSWEA_CODER_HOME 可以挪走用户的那个目录。

docs.title: 结果
docs.text:
task 工具返回一个 JSON 对象：

{
  "status": "completed",
  "summary": "The parser lives in src/parser.py and is called by the CLI.",
  "findings": ["src/parser.py:42 parses the arguments"],
  "files_touched": [],
  "cost": 0.031,
  "tokens_in": 12043,
  "tokens_out": 987,
  "turns": 7,
  "purpose": "cheap"
}
字段 是什么 status completed、max_turns 或者 error summary 子 agent 最后说的话。这就是结论 findings 这个结论里的要点 files_touched 它改过的文件。读过的文件不在里面 cost 它花的钱 tokens_in 它发出去的 token tokens_out 它收到的 token turns 它调了几次模型 purpose 替它回答的模型是哪个用途

轮数用完了、活还没干完时 status 是 max_turns；它的模型挂了时是 error。 error 会作为一次失败的调用回到主 agent，主 agent 就知道这个答案不可信。

子 agent 的钱是会话的钱：它算在这个会话的账单里，也算在 cost_limit 里。 当子 agent 跑在自己的模型上（model_purpose 被路由到别的模型），它的花费记在 主模型上，所以会话的预算照样管得住它。

docs.title: 权限
docs.text:
子 agent 的工具和主 agent 的工具走同一层权限。在 plan 模式下，子 agent 同样 不能写东西。

hook 也是同一套：PreToolUse hook 拦住一个工具，对子 agent 同样拦住；子 agent 写的文件也会做 checkpoint，/rewind 能把它退回去。子 agent 每次工具调用的结果 都落在会话的事件日志里。

task 工具本身是个要问的工具，和 bash 一样。没有终端就没人能回答，所以脚本 里这次调用会被拒：

coder --task "..." --permission-mode bypass

或者自己写一条规则：

# .coderagent/rules.yaml
rules:
  - tool: task
    pattern: "*"
    decision: allow

docs.title: The web interface
docs.text:
coder web runs the same agent in the browser. The chat page is the terminal interface with a window around it, and the settings page writes the model configuration for you — which is the part that is tedious in a text editor.

中文版：网页版

pip install -e ".[web]"      # fastapi, uvicorn and jinja2
cd my-project
coder web

The server prints the address it listens on and waits:

coder web: http://127.0.0.1:8765

Open that address in a browser.

docs.title: The command line
docs.text: Option What it does --cwd The directory the agent works in. Everything the browser shows is inside it, except the directories in permissions.include_dirs. --host The address to listen on. 127.0.0.1 by default. --port The port. 8765 by default. --model, -m The model of this run --config, -c A configuration file, or key=value overrides --permission-mode default, acceptEdits, plan, bypass or readonly

docs.title: The chat page (/)
docs.text:
Three columns:

  • Left: the sessions of the directory and the files of the working directory. New session starts one; clicking a session opens it.
  • Middle: the conversation. Messages are bubbles, tool calls are cards with the output and the diff of the change, approvals are cards with three buttons. The box under the conversation takes a message or a slash command (/help, /clear, /cost, … — the same commands as the terminal interface). Interrupt stops the turn that is running.

The page itself does not scroll: every column has its own scrollbar. The conversation follows the newest output, unless you scroll up to read something. The turns before the current one are folded into a block at the top — click it to look at them. - Right: the status bar of the session (model, context size, cost, mode), the sub agents with the turns they may really make, the files the session changed with their diff, and the file you are looking at.

Everything the agent does arrives over a server-sent event stream, so the output appears while it happens. Reconnecting to the page picks up where it left off.

The pieces of a streamed answer are only for the moment: they are pushed to the browser while they arrive but not kept, so a long answer cannot push the history of the session out of the buffer. A browser that comes late reads the whole answer as one message.

At the end of a turn the session is settled in the memory (see The memory), which shows up as a thin separator with what it cost.

docs.title: The settings page (/settings)
docs.text:
The model configuration, in a form:

Field What it is Model name model.model_name, e.g. deepseek/deepseek-flash. The provider in front of the name says who is called: openai/MiniMax-M2.7 for a third party endpoint, deepseek/deepseek-flash for DeepSeek Litellm config file model.litellm_config — the file with the aliases of the models API base model.model_kwargs.api_base — the address of the provider API key model.model_kwargs.api_key, or the key of the provider in the environment. A click shows it, a second click hides it again Retries model.max_retries Cache control model.set_cache_control Routing model.routing Routing rules model.routing_rules Extra parameters Everything else of model.model_kwargs

Under every field is the layer it comes from: defaults, project, user or env. The table at the bottom shows every layer, with the secrets taken out. The page reads the configuration files; the -m and -c of the command line are for the sessions, so with coder web -m deepseek/deepseek-flash the page still shows the model of the files.

The Example block under the fields shows how a third party endpoint is written: the model name is then an alias of the model list of a litellm config file, and the key of the endpoint stays in that file instead of the settings of the agent.

Test connection sends one cheap call to the model with the settings of the form, so you can see whether the key and the address work before you save. It reports five things:

What What it tells you The model The model the call goes to, and the alias it comes from The API base The address the call goes to The API key Whether a key is set, and its last four characters The aliases file Whether the file exists, whether it parses, and which aliases it has The tools Whether the model calls the tools — without that the agent cannot work

Test a model. A second panel tries a model out without saving anything: the endpoint, the key and the name of the model, and a Test connection button. It is the shape a provider hands them out in.

Field What it is Endpoint The address of the provider. The full address of the chat completions (https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions) is fine — the part behind /v1 is cut off, because litellm adds it itself API Key The key of that endpoint. A click shows the key of the settings above, a second click hides it again Model Name The name of the model. The provider in front of the name says who is called: openai/MiniMax-M2.7. Without one, the provider openai is added, because the endpoint is an OpenAI compatible one

An empty endpoint or an empty key means the one of the settings above. The result is the same four lines as the test of the form.

What is written where: only the user level file, ~/.coderagent/config.yaml (or $MSWEA_CODER_HOME/config.yaml). The project level file (.coderagent/config.yaml) is never written — it is in the repository. The sections the page does not know about are kept as they are; the comments in the file are lost.

A key in the environment is in the page. The page reads the configuration files first and then the environment: a provider key that comes from the environment (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and the like) is shown like any other key, and api_key_set is true. The layer under the field says env when the key comes from there. The name of the model says which variable is looked at: openai/… means OPENAI_API_KEY, deepseek/… means DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

The key of the field. The field of the key shows set (********1234) while the key itself stays hidden. A click on the field asks the server for the key and shows it; a second click hides it again. The key of the aliases file counts too: if the key lives in the litellm config file, that is the one that is shown. An empty field keeps the key that is set — the key is only sent when there is something in the field. The API is stricter about it: api_key: "" removes the stored key, and a missing api_key (or null) keeps it.

When it takes effect: the server keeps the configuration it started with. A new session reads the files again, so the new settings apply from the next session on. The session you are in keeps the model it has; use /model <name> to switch it right away.

docs.title: Permissions
docs.text:
The permissions are in two places, and they do different things.

Where What it changes When it takes effect The settings page (/settings) The permissions: section of the user level configuration file The next session The chat page (/) The mode of the session that is running Right away

docs.title: The modes
docs.text:
Mode What it means default Every tool that changes something asks for approval acceptEdits The writes go through, everything else asks plan Read only: the agent looks around and writes down the plan readonly Read only: the agent looks around and answers bypass Nothing is asked: every tool call is allowed. For unattended runs

plan and readonly refuse every tool that changes something, bash included, and the model is told about it, so it answers with what it found instead of changing anything.

docs.title: The settings page
docs.text:
The form has the mode, the denied paths and the extra directories, and it is written to the same user level file as the model: ~/.coderagent/config.yaml (or $MSWEA_CODER_HOME/config.yaml). The project level file is never written, and the rules of permissions.rules are left alone — those are the business of the Always allow button of the approvals.

Like the model, it takes effect for the new sessions: a session that is running keeps the mode it has.

docs.title: The chat page
docs.text: The inspector has a mode box at the top. Changing it switches the mode of the session that is running, without restarting anything: the policy is changed in place, so the next tool call sees it, and the model is told about it the next time the context is put together. This is what makes an unattended run easy — put the session on bypass before the test run, back to default afterwards.

docs.title: The mode the server was started with
docs.text:
coder web --permission-mode bypass pins the mode: it wins over the files, because the policy is built with permission_mode or config.permissions.mode. The settings page says so when the server was started with one, instead of letting you believe that a change in the file took effect.

The pin is the mode the sessions start with, not a lock: the chat page can still switch the mode of a session, because that is a decision you take in front of the session, not a setting of the file.

docs.title: The language of the pages
docs.text:
The pages are in Chinese for a visitor from a Chinese region (China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan) and in English everywhere else. The region of the visitor is what decides.

Where the region comes from How The proxy in front of the server The header it sets: CF-IPCountry, X-AppEngine-Country, X-Vercel-IP-Country, X-Country-Code The geoip database GeoLite2-Country.mmdb in ~/.coderagent/ (or the path in CODERAGENT_GEOIP_DB).
